selected_cutting_reference.title: Robotic Cutting of Solids Based on Fracture Mechanics and FEM
limitations: Printed modulus unit N/m is dimensionally inconsistent with a 3D Young modulus; do not silently import as Pa.
Modulus was adjusted using initial force-displacement slope, so the published number is not an independent held-out validation target.
Scanned specimen geometry and raw numeric force/torque histories were not obtained from the paper.
Quasi-static pressing experiment differs from a general dynamic slicing task.

secondary_experiment.title: Mechanical Performances of Isolated Cuticles Along Tomato Fruit Growth and Ripening
secondary_experiment.specimen: isolated Cascada cuticle, 55 days after anthesis
secondary_experiment.applicability: Isolated cuticle, not bulk flesh or a whole-fruit cutting law. Raw data are author-provided according to the article; none acquired here.

reference.conclusion: Current synthetic coefficients cannot be called experimentally validated. Copying reported parameters or matching a fitted value is not independent validation.
required_for_item17: Resolve units and choose the tissue/model scope explicitly.
Obtain a reproducible numerical curve plus specimen geometry/protocol, or a published dataset with these supplied.
Fit on a declared calibration subset and test separate deformation/failure data.
Check uncertainty and loading-rate applicability; report model discrepancies rather than retuning until a test passes.

limitations: Trace extracted from the vector path in a plotted figure, not instrument samples.
Axis uncertainty is a declared extraction assumption, not biological variability.
Alternating points from one curve are correlated; this is interpolation assessment, not independent experimental validation.
Descriptive fit is not the native cohesive or bulk material model.
Specimen scan, boundary conditions and independent repeat trials are not supplied by this extraction.

recommended_route: Use the published tomato figure provisionally; do not substitute simulated DiSECt fruit data for experimental validation. Obtain raw data/specimen details or collect matched trials before closing item 17.
